reviews.comment: Firstly, I know for a fact almost everyone in my class got A's, so idk why he is rated so low. Prof Henson is an enthusiastic lecturer who does a great job with nuance, covering details and broad ideas. Great class if you like social justice. He does expect good quality participation, so if you aren't down for that this isn't the class for you.

reviews.comment: I liked Henson a lot and the class was really interesting and engaging material. But the papers were all or nothing credit, so it was really stressful writing each paper bc you never really knew if you'd do it right or not. Office hours were really helpful and I ended up doing fine, just seemed unfair for zero partial credit on weekly long papers.

It's a really interesting course but if you have the chance to take it with a different professor - DO IT! Not only can you not miss more than 3 classes, but you're also counted late if you're more than 10 min. late, he will LOCK YOU OUT (usually by the 7 min.). He knows his stuff and has good insights - still doesn't make up for his technique..
